notes.title: Update on making Moonatees free
notes.content:
Before we make the game free we want to try out the effect of sales. We’ll try 1 or 2 of those and then change the price to 0€ as promised.

There is a possible problem about making the game free though. Based on this [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Vive/comments/629jlc/moonatees_now_available_on_steam_5_at_the_moment/] Reddit thread [/url]  it’s not entirely up to us to decide when we make the game free.

Apparently Steam don’t want people making games free to avoid hurt feelings for those who have paid for the games. We have been upfront about making the game free so hopefully we’ll be able to change the price without issue.
